loginRequired: Log in to see this community.

details.title: General
details.name: Name
details.descriptionHint: Shows on the community home page and on the invite page.

address.title: Address
address.confirm: The community moves to {address}. Saved links and messages already sent with {old}, such as Discord ones, stop working. Another community can claim this address. Invite links keep working.

members.label: Community members
members.empty: No one in the community yet.
members.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from the community? {name} loses access, leaves registrations in tournaments that haven't started and, in tournaments in progress, loses pending matches by walkover. History stays, and {name} can rejoin with an invite, as a player.

leave.title: Leave community
leave.confirm: You lose access, leave registrations in tournaments that haven't started and, in tournaments in progress, lose pending matches by walkover. Your name stays in the bracket of the tournaments you played, and you can rejoin with an invite, as a player, with the same nickname.

transfer.title: Transfer ownership
transfer.description: The chosen member becomes the owner and you become an organizer.
transfer.confirm: {name} becomes the community owner and you become an organizer. To get ownership back, {name} has to transfer it to you.
transfer.empty: There's no other member to receive ownership yet.

deletion.title: Delete community
deletion.description: The community is deleted 7 days after the request, with everything in it. Until then, it's read-only, and you can cancel. If any tournament is in progress, end it or undo its start first.
deletion.confirm: Schedule the community's deletion? On that date, it's permanently erased, with everything in it.
deletion.scheduled: The community will be deleted on <date></date>, with everything in it. Until then, it's read-only.

deletionNotice.title: Community being deleted
deletionNotice.text: This community will be deleted on <date></date>, with its tournaments and everything in it. Until then, it's read-only.
